name: Little Rock
intro: Little Rock is where I'm based, and it's where I've filmed more weddings than anywhere else — over ten years and 100+ weddings, a huge share of them right here. What I love about filming in this city is the range. In a single season I might shoot beneath the chandeliers of the Capital Hotel downtown, in the exposed-brick rooms of Loft 1023 a few blocks away, and out on the rolling forty acres of Grandeur House on the west side — three completely different films, all technically the same city.

Little Rock wedding days also come with their own rhythm: a church ceremony at Cathedral of St. Andrew or St. Edward, then a reception across town at the hotel, the club, or the hall. I've run that two-location day more times than I can count, and knowing the drive times, the parking, and where the light will be when we arrive is half of what makes those films feel calm instead of rushed. Whether your day is downtown-and-urban or tucked into the quiet acreage at the edge of the city, I've almost certainly filmed somewhere like it — and probably at your exact venue.

faqs.question: Do you charge a travel fee in Little Rock?
faqs.answer: No. Travel is included within 50 miles of Little Rock, and I'm based right here — so every Little Rock venue, from downtown to Chenal to the west-side acreage, is covered with no travel fee and no hidden costs.

faqs.question: How far in advance should we book?
faqs.answer: Popular Saturdays usually book nine to twelve months out, and I only take one wedding per date — once your date is reserved with a retainer, it's yours and no one else's. If your date is closer than that, still reach out; openings do happen.

faqs.question: When will we get our films?
faqs.answer: Your Instagram reel arrives within 48 hours of your wedding, while the day is still fresh. Your full film is delivered by a guaranteed date that goes in your contract in writing — no six-month mystery, no chasing your videographer.

faqs.question: Can you cover a church ceremony and a separate reception venue?
faqs.answer: Absolutely — that's a classic Little Rock wedding day, and I film them all the time. I plan the timeline around the drive between locations so nothing gets missed and nobody feels hurried, and every package covers both sites.
